insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 44% women's / 38% men's. Alo skews 53% women's, Gymshark 22% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +8% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (149) vs Lululemon (95). Vuori leads by 54.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 47% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1256 vs 815 products. A 54% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 503 products. Behind Gymshark (963).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 475 products vs Lululemon's 286. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 23,551 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 3,296 = 12% share of tracked catalog.
